Name: Ancestral Trees - Obelisk Replacement for Content Patcher
Author: laloulalou
Description:
A simple mod to replace the obelisks sold by the Wizard with beautiful trees from the area they teleport you to! Comes with three variants: simple, detailed & with birds (the birds are not animated).

[u][b]HOW TO INSTALL
[/b][/u]1. Install the latest version of [b]Smapi[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]
2. Drop Ancestral Trees into your Mods folder
3. To switch between variants, copy the one you want from its subfolder and paste it in [b]/assets[/b] to replace the current version. The default variant is the one with birds.

This is my first mod, hope you enjoy it!

Downloads.Description:
Now with seasonal changes! Wow!!! (If you don't like the changes, use previous version)

Options: Simple, Detailed or With Bird. To change between options, grab the ones you like from their folder and replace the files at the root of the "assets" folder.
